notes: J27 (Jay via the Manager): seal callout subtitles use the REAL Action Zone technique names, because they teach the terms. Drop-in for content/abilities/abilities.json seals[0..9]: same ids, same order, same text and effect; only 'name' changes and the old name goes in 'altName' (as #414 did). 'subtitle' is the line under the 'Self-Defense #N!' callout (technique-callouts.json). Each proposed name is copied word for word (title case) from the 'What the student does' column of docs/self-defense.md, at the file and line in 'source'. docs/curriculum.md names no technique steps. OPEN = no single clear real name; the seal keeps its current name until Jay picks. 'about' is a new 8-words-or-fewer line; 'text' is unchanged game text. PROPOSAL only: nothing is renamed in game files. When the Programmer copies a seal over, drop 'technique', 'subtitle', 'callout', 'about', 'source', 'status' and 'openNote' unless the loader takes them. Check: drafts/content/tools/check-j27-seal-names.py.
